You are helping coordinate a post-flood search-and-rescue operation in Nepal.

The rules of the operation:
- Cars drive along the listed roads. A damaged or blocked road cannot be used. Driving a road takes its stated number of minutes.
- People wait at locations. Each person is injured, a child, an elderly person, or an adult (an injured person counts only as injured, whatever their age). People at the same location may be split between cars or trips.
- A car can carry at most its stated number of passengers at once.
- People can only be dropped off at an evacuation point (a designated safe location). Anywhere else does not count.
- Every person must end up either rescued (dropped at an evacuation point) or deferred to a later rescue wave.
- Deferring has a penalty per person: injured 80, child 60, elderly 50, adult 20 (measured in minutes of driving).
- The plan ends when everyone is rescued or deferred. Cars do not need to return anywhere.
- Goal: minimise total cost = total driving minutes of all cars + penalties for deferred people.

Use the identifiers in square brackets (without the brackets) for cars and locations, and the words injured, child, elderly, adult for the bands.

Do not plan the rescue yourself. Instead, translate the field report into a PDDL problem file for the domain below, so that a classical planner can find the optimal plan.

Requirements for the problem file:
- (:domain flood-rescue)
- Object names: use the bracketed identifiers exactly for locations and cars. The bands injured, child, elderly, adult and the level n0 are domain constants, so do not declare them. Declare level objects n1 ... nK, where K is the larger of the car capacity and the largest number of people of one band at one location.
- List each road in both directions with (road a b), its (= (travel-time a b) minutes), and (damaged a b) if it cannot be used.
- (evac-point x) for every evacuation point.
- For every car: (car-at c x), (free-seats c nS) with S its capacity, and (carrying c b n0) for each of the four bands.
- (waiting x b nN) for every location and band with N > 0 people waiting.
- (sum a b c) for every a + b = c within n0 ... nK, and (positive n) for n1 ... nK.
- (= (defer-cost b nN) P) for each band and each N in 1 ... K, where P = per-person penalty x N.
- (= (total-cost) 0) in :init.
- Goal: (waiting x b n0) for every (x, b) that had people waiting, and (carrying c b n0) for every car and band.
- (:metric minimize (total-cost))

Return only the complete problem file inside a single ```pddl code block.

The domain:
```pddl
;; Plan, Search, Rescue! -- post-flood rescue domain (CS3263 Group 11)
;;
;; Cars drive along roads between locations, pick up civilians and drop them
;; at evacuation points. Damaged roads cannot be used.
;;
;; People are counted per band (injured, child, elderly, adult), so a
;; car can take any number of them that fits, and the people at one location
;; can be split across cars or trips.
;;
;; Priorities use soft goals compiled into action costs (Keyder & Geffner 2009):
;; everyone must end up either delivered to an evacuation point (cost: driving
;; time) or deferred to a later rescue wave (cost: a per-person penalty,
;; highest for the injured, then children, then the elderly, then adults).
;; Minimising total-cost therefore trades travel time against people deferred.
;;
;; Classical PDDL has no integer arithmetic in preconditions, so counts are
;; level objects n0, n1, ... with a static (sum ?a ?b ?c) relation meaning
;; a + b = c, and (positive ?n) for n > 0.
;; (Parameter names avoid ?before/?after, which VAL treats as keywords.)
;;
;; The earlier version, where each group had to travel together, is kept in
;; no-split/ for comparison.

(define (domain flood-rescue)
  (:requirements :strips :typing :negative-preconditions :action-costs)

  (:types location car band level)

  (:constants
    n0 - level
    injured child elderly adult - band)

  (:predicates
    (road ?from ?to - location)                    ; a road exists (listed in both directions)
    (damaged ?from ?to - location)                 ; road cannot be used by a car
    (evac-point ?l - location)                     ; safe drop-off location
    (car-at ?c - car ?l - location)
    (waiting ?l - location ?b - band ?n - level)   ; n people of band b still at l
    (carrying ?c - car ?b - band ?n - level)       ; n people of band b in car c
    (free-seats ?c - car ?n - level)
    (sum ?a ?b ?c - level)                         ; a + b = c
    (positive ?n - level))                         ; n > 0

  (:functions
    (total-cost) - number
    (travel-time ?from ?to - location) - number
    (defer-cost ?b - band ?n - level) - number)    ; penalty for deferring n people of band b

  (:action drive
    :parameters (?c - car ?from ?to - location)
    :precondition (and (car-at ?c ?from)
                       (road ?from ?to)
                       (not (damaged ?from ?to)))
    :effect (and (not (car-at ?c ?from))
                 (car-at ?c ?to)
                 (increase (total-cost) (travel-time ?from ?to))))

  ;; Pick up ?m people of band ?b at the car's location.
  (:action load
    :parameters (?c - car ?l - location ?b - band ?m ?w ?rest ?k ?k2 ?f ?f2 - level)
    :precondition (and (car-at ?c ?l)
                       (positive ?m)
                       (waiting ?l ?b ?w) (sum ?rest ?m ?w)
                       (carrying ?c ?b ?k) (sum ?k ?m ?k2)
                       (free-seats ?c ?f) (sum ?f2 ?m ?f))
    :effect (and (not (waiting ?l ?b ?w)) (waiting ?l ?b ?rest)
                 (not (carrying ?c ?b ?k)) (carrying ?c ?b ?k2)
                 (not (free-seats ?c ?f)) (free-seats ?c ?f2)))

  ;; Drop off everyone of band ?b in the car at an evacuation point.
  (:action unload
    :parameters (?c - car ?l - location ?b - band ?k ?f ?f2 - level)
    :precondition (and (car-at ?c ?l)
                       (evac-point ?l)
                       (positive ?k)
                       (carrying ?c ?b ?k)
                       (free-seats ?c ?f) (sum ?f ?k ?f2))
    :effect (and (not (carrying ?c ?b ?k)) (carrying ?c ?b n0)
                 (not (free-seats ?c ?f)) (free-seats ?c ?f2)))

  ;; Leave everyone of band ?b still waiting at ?l for a later rescue wave.
  (:action defer-rescue
    :parameters (?l - location ?b - band ?w - level)
    :precondition (and (waiting ?l ?b ?w)
                       (positive ?w))
    :effect (and (not (waiting ?l ?b ?w)) (waiting ?l ?b n0)
                 (increase (total-cost) (defer-cost ?b ?w))))
)

```

FIELD REPORT

FIELD REPORT - Nuwakot district flood response (scenario large-15)

Our team has two cars available, each able to carry four passengers. Currently: [car1] at Suryagadhi shelter [suryagadhi-shelter]; [car2] at Kalika hospital [kalika-hospital].

SAFE LOCATIONS
Suryagadhi shelter [suryagadhi-shelter] is above the flood line and is taking in evacuees.
Kalika hospital [kalika-hospital] is on high ground and its staff are receiving evacuees.
Tadi temple [tadi-temple] sits on higher ground, but it has no food, water or medical staff and the authorities have not designated it as a place to bring people.

ROAD CONDITIONS
- The Likhu temple [likhu-temple] to Myagang village [myagang-village] road is muddy but passable, about 55 minutes by car.
- A landslide has buried the road between Kispang market [kispang-market] and Tarkeshwar farm [tarkeshwar-farm] (normally a 14-minute drive).
- It is a 12-minute drive between Suryagadhi shelter [suryagadhi-shelter] and Galchhi village [galchhi-village], with some debris but no blockages.
- It is a 5-minute drive between Nilkantha market [nilkantha-market] and Thakre farm [thakre-farm], with some debris but no blockages.
- Drivers report the road between Kispang market [kispang-market] and Dhunche school [dhunche-school] is clear; it takes roughly 19 minutes.
- It is a 15-minute drive between Tarkeshwar farm [tarkeshwar-farm] and Myagang village [myagang-village], with some debris but no blockages.
- The Gajuri farm [gajuri-farm] to Likhu temple [likhu-temple] road is muddy but passable, about 16 minutes by car.
- The drive from Likhu temple [likhu-temple] to Nilkantha market [nilkantha-market] takes about 28 minutes.
- Drivers report the road between Gajuri farm [gajuri-farm] and Galchhi village [galchhi-village] is clear; it takes roughly 17 minutes.
- The Kispang market [kispang-market] to Tadi temple [tadi-temple] road is muddy but passable, about 15 minutes by car.
- The Kalika hospital [kalika-hospital] to Galchhi village [galchhi-village] road is muddy but passable, about 11 minutes by car.
- Floodwater is running fast over the Thakre farm [thakre-farm] to Tadi temple [tadi-temple] road; a truck was swept off it this morning. The drive usually takes 12 minutes.
- The bridge on the Myagang village [myagang-village] to Dhunche school [dhunche-school] road (18 minutes in normal conditions) was washed away last night.
- It is a 27-minute drive between Suryagadhi shelter [suryagadhi-shelter] and Gajuri farm [gajuri-farm], with some debris but no blockages.
- Floodwater is running fast over the Tarkeshwar farm [tarkeshwar-farm] to Dhunche school [dhunche-school] road; a truck was swept off it this morning. The drive usually takes 15 minutes.
- Drivers report the road between Nilkantha market [nilkantha-market] and Tadi temple [tadi-temple] is clear; it takes roughly 15 minutes.
- Drivers report the road between Kalika hospital [kalika-hospital] and Gajuri farm [gajuri-farm] is clear; it takes roughly 7 minutes.
Any road not listed here does not exist or cannot be used.

STRANDED CIVILIANS
- At Nilkantha market [nilkantha-market], residents report four people in their late seventies and eighties and two residents with fractures and cuts waiting for help.
- At Tadi temple [tadi-temple], residents report an old man who cannot walk unaided and three adult labourers waiting for help.
- At Likhu temple [likhu-temple], residents report four frail senior citizens waiting for help.
- At Gajuri farm [gajuri-farm], residents report four adult labourers waiting for help.
- At Galchhi village [galchhi-village], residents report two pensioners waiting for help.
- At Tarkeshwar farm [tarkeshwar-farm], residents report four shopkeepers waiting for help.
- At Thakre farm [thakre-farm], residents report two working-age adults waiting for help.
Families have said they are willing to travel separately if needed.
